guide.summary: Peace memorials, museums, gardens and Miyajima's shrine and ropeway, with okonomiyaki, bakeries, coffee and hotel bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Reserve online if you want an early-morning or evening slot at the Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum, which closes December 30–31, and remember the Hiroshima Prefectural Art Museum closes on Mondays and Main Bar Mayflower on Sundays.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Hiroshima Prefectural Art Museum closes on Mondays, Main Bar Mayflower on Sundays, and the Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum on December 30–31. The Miyajima Public Aquarium closes from December 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: Early-morning and evening entry to the Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum requires an online reservation, and adult tickets cost ¥200. Miyajima Ropeway requires a reservation on the dates it lists, including every November weekend through November 29.

toolkit.label: Walk-ins and queues
toolkit.copy: Anagomeshi Ueno takes no reservations for its first-floor restaurant, and reserved bento customers queue in the same line. The Peace Memorial Museum warns you may wait even with a web ticket.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: Itsukushima Shrine warns that high heels may get stuck between its corridor floorboards, so wear comfortable shoes. Peace Memorial Park bans barbecues, fireworks and other open flames, and the area inside the A-Bomb Dome fence is closed.

guide.dek: Give Peace Memorial Park and its museum a full morning, book any early or late museum slot online, and save a separate day for Miyajima.
intro: Start at Peace Memorial Park, which the city lists at Nakajima-cho 1 and Otemachi 1-10. The area inside the A-Bomb Dome fence is closed, so you view the dome from outside, and barbecues, fireworks and other open flames are banned. The Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum opens at 7:30 am and closes at 7:00 pm from March through July and September through November, and at 6:00 pm from December through February. Early-morning and evening entry slots need an online reservation, adult admission is ¥200, and the museum closes December 30–31. Its New Arrivals Exhibit runs until February 23, 2027.

Hiroshima Castle's main keep closed in March 2026 because of concrete deterioration and ageing equipment, though you can still view it from outside, and the reconstructed Ninomaru buildings are free to enter. From October through March they open 9:00 am to 4:30 pm. Nearby, the Hiroshima Prefectural Art Museum shows its Kumi Sugai exhibition until December 6, 2026, stays open until 7:00 pm on Fridays until March 31, 2027, and closes on Mondays (it opens on holiday Mondays during special exhibitions). The Hiroshima Museum of Art runs Artists at the Café, from the Impressionists to Picasso, until January 11, 2027.

On Miyajima, Itsukushima Shrine charges adults ¥300, and its admission page warns that high heels can catch in the gaps between corridor floorboards. Miyajima Ropeway ran upward cars from 9:00 am to 4:00 pm on the day checked, and you must reserve a ride on the dates it lists, which include every November weekend through November 29. Daisho-in temple's gate is open 8:00 am to 5:00 pm. If you are travelling with children, the Miyajima Public Aquarium closes from December 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027. Yamadaya's main store on the island sells momiji manju daily from 9:00 am to 6:00 pm.

For okonomiyaki, Mitchan Sohonten's Hatchobori main store serves lunch and dinner, with last orders 30 minutes before closing; its store page lists no regular closing day, but it posted a notice about a change of closing days on October 28, 2026, so check before you go. Hiroshima Andersen on Hondori opens its Bakery Market at 10:00 am, and its restaurant opens at 7:30 am on weekends and holidays, with dinner served as a buffet. Anagomeshi Ueno at Miyajimaguchi takes no reservations for its first-floor restaurant. For a nightcap, Main Bar Mayflower at Hotel Granvia Hiroshima opens 5:00 pm to 11:00 pm and closes on Sundays.
summaryCards: Pair Peace Memorial Park with the Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum, reserving online for an early-morning or evening slot, and note the museum closes December 30–31.
Hiroshima Andersen's restaurant opens at 7:30 am on weekends and holidays, and Obscura Coffee Roasters on Hondori lists 9:00 am to 7:00 pm on its shop page.
Check closing days: the Hiroshima Prefectural Art Museum closes on Mondays, Main Bar Mayflower on Sundays, and the Miyajima Public Aquarium from December 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Some places were published only partially: Orizuru Tower's hours appear only as an image; Peace Memorial Park, Café Jardin, Sky Lounge Top of Hiroshima, The Lounge, Taoli and Fruitier publish no readable hours; the Peace Memorial Hall shows only the day's hours; Mitchan Sohonten's October 28, 2026 closing-day change notice could not be read. Itsukushima Shrine (footer © 2015), Anagomeshi Ueno (footer © 2015) and Obscura Coffee Roasters show hours on undated pages with no 2026 content, so treat those hours as published, not verified current. Hiroshima Castle's main keep closed in March 2026, and the Hiroshima Museum of Art plans a renovation closure from August 1, 2027. Sites that could not be read: Okonomimura and Hiroshima Botanical Garden (connection refused), Fujiiya (HTTP 403), Iwaso and Otafuku Wood Egg (404), Hiroshima Carp (title only), and several assumed domains that did not resolve (Nagata-ya, Kakiya, Sheraton Grand Hiroshima, Hilton Hiroshima, Miyajima Brewery, Hiroshima City Transportation Museum). The Hiroshima City Museum of Contemporary Art and Mazda Museum were left out because no address and hours, or no street address, were readable.
